scenes.headline: Tiger-reserve trip prep: signs before stripes
Before the trip, we brief everyone on what tigers leave behind
scenes.body: Footage: Amur tiger being released, Russia.

scenes.headline: Ground scrapes, claw marks on trees, scent marks
scenes.body: Tigers are solitary and hold territories partly through these signs.

scenes.headline: Tigers are strong swimmers that seem to enjoy bathing

caption:
Most of a tiger trip is reading the forest

Tigers evolved in cooler forests of eastern Asia and handle heat less well than other big cats - one likely reason they take to water.

Source: Britannica. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: BTS of trip prep that sets honest expectations (signs, not guaranteed sightings). Briefing content to be confirmed by Muddy Lessons; captive and release footage is labelled on screen.
